name: Partition Literature
description: Emotional, historical narrative dealing with the trauma, displacement, and survival during 1947.

chapters.title: The Peaceful Village
chapters.description: Life before the divide; communities living together in harmony.

chapters.title: The Rumors
chapters.description: Whispers of lines being drawn; the slow poisoning of minds.

chapters.title: The Line in the Sand
chapters.description: The announcement of the border; realizing they are on the 'wrong' side.

chapters.title: The Night of Terror
chapters.description: Riots break out; neighbors turn against neighbors.

chapters.title: The Escape
chapters.description: Leaving everything behind; the desperate journey to the border.

chapters.title: The Train Journey
chapters.description: A harrowing, dangerous passage filled with loss and horror.

chapters.title: The Refugee Camp
chapters.description: Arriving with nothing; disease, hunger, and searching for lost family.

chapters.title: The Unlikely Savior
chapters.description: An act of extreme kindness from someone of the 'other' side.

chapters.title: Rebuilding from Ashes
chapters.description: Finding a new home; the struggle for daily survival in a new city.

chapters.title: The Ghost of the Past
chapters.description: A reminder of what was lost; dealing with PTSD and survivor's guilt.

chapters.title: The Next Generation
chapters.description: Passing on the stories, or choosing silence to protect the children.

chapters.title: The Acceptance
chapters.description: Finding peace, even if the longing for the ancestral home never dies.
